protocol.question: In the frozen full12/coarse8 fields, how is sampled local predicted deformation distributed algebraically between masked Hash-latent H and all Identity conditions C?

selection.decision: Three improvement criteria passed but P1cap100% failed; one frozen interpretation diagnostic, no secondseed/cutoff/loss sweep.
selection.CAD_choice: Previously fixed TRAIN specialist/precision case; not chosen by current model error ranking.
selection.checkpoint: Each own known-load u-selected best9000, no updates or checkpoint reselection.
selection.case_scope: One seen TRAIN CAD and the existing3 basis readouts ver/hor/tor; not a validation or final-test population.

sampling.BC_change_definition: Any original input bits0:7 differ among the four original tetra corners.
sampling.selection_order: Read only input geometry/BC membership, freeze selected indices/hash before model predictions or reference tensors.
sampling.policy: Uniform without replacement in the BC-change stratum up to512; fill remaining1024 from no-change stratum, as available; no redraw/error selection.
sampling.report: Stratum population/sample sizes and inclusion fractions; conditional physical-volume weighted sample statistics, no whole-CAD population estimate.

data.prepared_members: Only normalized xyz/original input features plus scalar input/key/alignment metadata, no displacement or stress arrays.
data.gradient_geometry: data/geobc_gradient_supervision/101_479.npz original cornerindices/physical inverse/absvolumes and existing source metadata
data.reference_permission: Only existing same-TRAIN selected-cell reference_cell_tensor_strain for3knownloads after input-only selection; no prepared/raw displacement or stress labels.
data.geometry_context: Each completed newrun geometry_clouds.npz points/mask/cad_keys/node_indices; only TRAIN101_479 row, canonical actual BC5 cloud.

function.layout: H24 (already full12/coarse8 masked), C107, same13ones -> public Network144/9
function.capture: Natural response_basis on selected real corners; public Network forward prehook captures assembled144 inputs, no private buffer offsets.
function.F11: f(Hk,Ck), must bitwise replay original frozen response_basis at the same corners before interpreting hybrids.
function.anchor: Actual original tetra corner0; no mean/midpoint condition
function.interaction: F11-F10-F01+F00; retain raw signed values in local artifact or summaries of components/norms and both directed-path RMS.
function.calls: One9basis natural preparation plus oneF11 replay and3hybrid Network batches permodel,5Network forwards/model; one context/Hash natural preparation reused across3loads.
function.arithmetic: Native FP16 inference/FP32 masters unchanged; promote9basis outputs toFP64 before signed differences, common u_scale_mm.05511113670847156 and center0.

physical_readout.operator: Frozen cell_tensor_strain with physical-mm cachedinverse applied to same sampled corner differences; symmetric tensor shear squared weight2.
physical_readout.closure: P1_pred=P1_H+P1_C; Epred=EH+EC+2<H,C> with true signed cross.
physical_readout.error_closure: Eerror=EH+EC+ER+2<H,C>-2<H,R>-2<C,R>; algebraic bookkeeping only, not causal GT-error allocation.
physical_readout.statistics: Perknownload and inputstratum plus combined diagnostic sample: physical-volume weighted RMS and energies, interaction tensor/RMS, reference RMS, sampled-cell relativeL2 when refenergy>1e-24 else null, and exact closure residuals.
physical_readout.input_witness: BC bit-change count and corner differences for local13, smooth-original, Euclidean5, query32, global32; descriptive co-occurrence, no extra ablation or fittedthreshold.
physical_readout.tolerances: F11 replay exact equality; FP64 delta/P1/energy identities rtol1e-10 atol1e-14, never silently discard cross/cancellation.

runtime.preferred: One root-scheduled CUDA no-grad process; sequential frozen models; no optimizer/backwards/update, no newnative acceptance probe.
runtime.budget: 1024cells/4096corners permodel, twofrozenmodels only; runtime estimatedseconds, measure actual.
runtime.release: New tool ready plus one independent focused math/interface review; master singlequeue.

interpretation.H: MaskedHash-latent path sensitivity, not isolated physical frequency causality.
interpretation.C: ALL107 conditions including smooth/affine coordinate-derived originals, BCbits/local13/distances/query/global; cannot label allC as discrete BC/local13 error.
interpretation.hybrids: Actual-corner latent/condition swaps are off-manifold counterfactuals; conventional symmetric interaction allocation, not physically independent causes.
interpretation.sample: Input-stratified1024cells from one seenCAD; not newglobal field, allnode metric, validation transfer or remeshing proof.
interpretation.precision: Finalu FP16 oracle does not exclude internal/input FP16 arithmetic and amplification.
interpretation.next: Root selects exactly one bounded follow-up from actual result; no automatic channel removal/loss/radius/model sweep or parameter update.

local_metadata.limitations: Discrete KNN/PCA depends on mesh-node density. Distance is to boundary nodes, not the continuous triangle surface; no sign or exact SDF is inferred. No uniform surface sampling is used.

distance_metadata.geometry_policy: originalprepare float32 vertices promoted toFP64 for physical edge lengths

tetra10_order.note: Curved quadratic surfaces may have nonzero midpoint deviation; no nodes are moved.

graph_topology.edges: 12 corner-mid subedges per originalTETRA10; unique; no RBE shortcuts

normalization.source: only existing canonical prepared geometry metadata; no H5/raw geometry scan

gradient_metadata.reference: reference corner-P1 tensor strain from signed known-load displacement

contract.reference_container_read: After witness commit, NumPy decompresses the complete same-TRAIN reference_cell_tensor_strain member; only selected cells enter diagnostics. This does not claim1024-row ZIP byte access.
contract.cloud_container_read: Only selected TRAIN row is decoded; ZIP seeks can decompress skipped bytes. Other CAD rows are not materialized or used.
